description: Admin Panel UI: Enhance the Interested Leads section with 48h countdown, overdue highlighting, loan type display, documentation status, and a Transfer button that lets admin reassign a lead to a different agent.
steps: 1. In public/admin/index.html, update the Interested Leads table header to add columns: Loan Type, Time Remaining, Status, and Action (Transfer).

2. Update the renderInterestedLeads() function to use the new expanded API response. For each lead, show: phone, name (leadName), agent name, loan type, time remaining (formatted as 'XXh YYm' or 'OVERDUE' in red), documentation status (Complete/Pending badge), and a Transfer button.
3. Add CSS for overdue styling: if a lead is overdue (48h expired and documentation not complete), highlight the row with a red-ish background and show 'OVERDUE' in red bold text.
4. Add CSS for the documentation status badge: green for complete, amber/gray for pending.

5. Add a Transfer button in each row. On click, show a small inline dropdown or modal that lists all agents (fetched from GET /api/admin/agents-list) excluding the current owner. When admin selects an agent and confirms, call POST /api/admin/transfer-interested with { numberId, newAgentId }. On success, show toast and refresh the list.
6. Add a transfer modal (#transferModal) with: agent select dropdown (populated from /api/admin/agents-list), confirm button, cancel button. Store the numberId being transferred.
7. Update the fetchInterestedLeads() function to use the expanded response and re-render with new columns.

8. Add a live countdown tick for the admin panel (similar to the break timer tick pattern already in the admin). Every second, update the 'Time Remaining' column for all non-completed interested leads without re-fetching.
9. Add CSS styles for the transfer modal and the new table columns. Follow existing admin panel design patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Admin panel Interested Leads table shows columns: Phone, Name, Agent, Loan Type, Time Remaining, Status, Action
Overdue leads (48h expired + documentation not complete) are visually highlighted with red background/text
Each lead row has a Transfer button that opens a modal with an agent dropdown
Completing a transfer updates the lead's owner and refreshes the table
Documentation status shows as a green 'Complete' badge or amber 'Pending' badge
The time remaining column shows a live countdown in 'XXh YYm' format
verification: Verify the admin HTML file has valid syntax by checking balanced script tags and HTML structure
Run the server and confirm the admin panel loads without JavaScript errors (check via curl that /admin returns HTML)
findings: All 9 steps implemented. Admin interested leads table updated with 7 columns (Phone, Name, Agent, Loan Type, Time Remaining, Status, Action). Transfer modal added with agent dropdown from /api/admin/agents-list. Overdue rows highlighted with red background. Doc status badges (green Complete, amber Pending). Live countdown tick every 1s updates time remaining. Overdue stat card added to stats grid. overdueInterestedCount displayed both in stats grid and as badge next to interested count header. Server starts cleanly, all syntax validations pass.
